decisive_items: Dense granulomatous infiltrate in the upper dermis consisting of histiocytes, lymphocytes, foam cells, multinucleated giant cells, eosinophils, and hemorrhage
central diabetes insipidus, growth retardation, and hypothyroidism
response.rationale: Only candidate R6 is supplied. Its raw spans jointly support Erdheim-Chester disease through a non-Langerhans histiocytic infiltrate with foam cells and multinucleated giant cells, CD68 positivity, and central diabetes insipidus with multisystem endocrine involvement. No competing candidate or contradicting raw span is present.
